notes_for_editor: Coordinates conflict: the Register gives 40.840149, -121.175983, while the record's West US Lookouts point is 40.82361, -121.16222, about 2.2 km apart. Neither is corrected here, and the story gives only the county and forest. The height of 13.7 m is the 45-foot tower; the Register gives no cab height. Only two sources exist, and the Forest Lookouts page has only a location code. Status, staffing and access were not found in two searches. Search results mixed in the Black Mountain lookout near Milford in Plumas NF, a different tower, which is not used.
